final: WITH site_mesh AS (SELECT m.zoneref, s.entrystat, m.facetfaces FROM scanmesh m JOIN sites s ON (m.zoneref COLLATE BINARY) = (s.zoneregistry COLLATE BINARY)), group_avg AS (SELECT zoneref, entrystat, AVG(facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM site_mesh GROUP BY zoneref, entrystat), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces FROM group_avg), paired AS (SELECT g.zoneref, g.entrystat, g.avg_faces, g.avg_faces - o.avg_faces AS diff_overall FROM group_avg g CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE o.avg_faces IS NOT NULL), status_avg AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces FROM paired GROUP BY entrystat), kept AS (SELECT p.avg_faces, p.diff_overall, p.avg_faces - s.avg_faces AS diff_status FROM paired p JOIN status_avg s ON (p.entrystat COLLATE BINARY) = (s.entrystat COLLATE BINARY) WHERE p.avg_faces > s.avg_faces) SELECT AVG(avg_faces) AS average_group_average, AVG(diff_overall) AS average_difference_from_overall, AVG(diff_status) AS average_difference_from_status FROM kept
